description: This file is a Java implementation class for ModuleConfigurationDao, providing methods to retrieve module configurations and by code from a database using QueryDSL and JPA, extending a generic DAO implementation.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of module configuration data access object, enabling retrieval of module configuration data from the database.

methods.name: getModulesConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IntegrationModule objects filtered by the specified module name.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a single IntegrationModule object by its unique module code.
